title: Constant evaluation with no nonconstant support
statement: Let $r$ and $\ell$ be nonnegative integers, and let a coefficient family assign an element of $\mathbb{F}_2$ to each subset of $\{1,\ldots,r\}$ of size at most $\ell$. If no nonempty subset has a nonzero coefficient, then the resulting polynomial evaluation is the constant function whose value is the coefficient of the empty set.
